Clock skew between IdP and SP: assertion not yet valid or already expired
Redirect URI not registered for the client in the IdP
LDAP bind rejected with result 49 (invalid credentials): check the IdP's service account bind credential
Directory rejected a user's own password (result 49): usually a wrong password, not an outage
Unknown user at the IdP; for directory users, check the IdP's LDAP bind first

RADIUS shared secret mismatch between the NAS and the server: packets dropped without a reply
RADIUS server not responding to the NAS (shared secret mismatch or server unreachable)
NAS is not in the RADIUS server's client list (new IP address or NAT)
Directory rejected the password; if every user fails, suspect a shared secret mismatch without Message-Authenticator
Reverse proxy got no valid answer from the app behind it (502): check proxy_pass (http:// versus https://, port) and that the app is where the proxy expects
Reverse proxy gave up waiting for the app behind it (504): the app, or something it calls, is slower than the proxy's read timeout
Reverse proxy's rate limit refused the request (429) before the IdP saw it: check the limit's rate and burst, and whether every user shares one client address
Reverse proxy is the likely cause, even though nginx logs nothing: it sends the IdP wrong X-Forwarded-Port, -Proto or -Host headers, so the SAML request's Destination does not match the IdP's own URL
IdP's response headers (its session cookies) are too big for the reverse proxy's buffer (502): raise proxy_buffer_size
